history.summary: A 48-unit freehold shoebox/serviced-apartment block in Geylang with only 14 URA transactions — the high headline appreciation (6.8%) rests on too thin a sample to trust, and the development is small, niche and carries Geylang stigma. Despite a high MMR, the exit-liquidity case is weak for an investment hold.
history.rating_rationale: 721sqft 2BR at $1.10M / $1,526 psf is ~20% below the project median PSF ($1,896) on paper, but with just 14 URA transactions the 6.8% CAGR is statistically unreliable and the 48-unit block offers thin, slow liquidity. Freehold and decent 5%+ rental yield (Aljunied/Paya Lebar tenant demand) are real positives, but Geylang-fringe stigma narrows the resale buyer pool. MMR 1563 / score 863 overstates the case given the data thinness.
red_flags: Only 48 units — illiquid, slow resale, limited amenities
Just 14 URA transactions — appreciation rate unreliable
Geylang/Sims Avenue stigma narrows buyer pool
Serviced-apartment / shoebox character limits owner-occupier demand
catalysts: Strong rental yield (~5%) from Aljunied/Paya Lebar tenant pool
Walkable to Aljunied EW9 and Paya Lebar interchange
